title: Pullback compatibility of the zero locus
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism, and let $M$ and $N$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. For an $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism $\varphi:M\to N$, one has $\varphi.zeroLocus.comap\,g=(g^*\varphi).zeroLocus$, where $g^*$ is the module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Convert the two Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible hypotheses to SheafOfModules.IsInvertible using IsInvertible.sheafOfModules_isInvertible [lem-pc-invertible-sheaf-instance].

Obtain an adjunction tensorPullback g ⊣ pushforward g from nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction [def-pc-module-pullback]. Mathlib pullbackPushforwardAdjunction exhibits pullback g as another left adjoint of the same pushforward. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq gives a natural isomorphism e : tensorPullback g ≅ pullback g. Only existence of this isomorphism is used; no section normalization or arbitrary witness is retained in a definition.

Apply the already proved source theorem Hom.comap_zeroLocus to rewrite the left-hand side as the zero locus of (pullback g).map φ. That source theorem contains the affine-local proof: common trivializations [lem-pc-invertible-common-free-generator], free generators after abstract pullback [lem-pc-zero-scheme-pullback-full-local-coefficient], the affine extension formula [lem-pc-ideal-sheaf-comap-affine-extension], and local zero-locus ideals [lem-pc-zero-scheme-ideal-local], followed by affine-cover locality. Thus none of these source declarations is changed or withdrawn, and the tensor-specific local-coefficient theorem is unnecessary.

Naturality of e.inv at φ gives the commutative square between (pullback g).map φ and (tensorPullback g).map φ, with vertical isomorphisms e.symm.app M and e.symm.app N. Package it with Arrow.isoMk. The proved source theorem Hom.zeroLocus_eq_of_arrowIso identifies the two zero loci, finishing the equality. This is transport along an isomorphism, with no new geometric lemma.

proof_origin.place: Hom.comap_zeroLocus and Hom.zeroLocus_eq_of_arrowIso; nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction; Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq. T5 reuses the closed source proof and transports along the natural isomorphism of left adjoints.
